NIPC #74-228
Mr. Sigmund C. Ziejewski
Regional Transportation Engineer
Illinois Department of Transportation
300 North State Street
Chicago, Illinois 60610
SUBJECT: NIPC Project No. 74-228 Illinois Department of Transportation - Funding for improvements to FAP Route 23 (Lincoln Highway) from
Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road in Cook County.
ATTENTION: Mr. Richard Garrity
Dear Mr. Ziejewski:
This is to notify you that the above referenced project has been reviewed in accordance with the "Metropolitan Clearinghouse" procedures currently in effect in this agency.
At a meeting held May 8, 1974, the Commission, through its Planning Committee, found the proposed project to be consistent with regional planning policies as set forth in the <u>Comprehensive General Plan</u> and with currently adopted Commission plans and programs.
Under procedures adopted jointly by this agency and the Northwestern Indiana Regional Planning Commission, this project is judged to be of interstate significance and must, therefore, be submitted to the Interstate Planning Committee for its review. The findings of the Committee will be forwarded to you shortly after its next meeting.
We are enclosing a summary of any comments that have been received in regard to your application. These comments, along with this letter, should be forwarded to the appropriate federal agency without any further communication with this office.
